usual_approach.note: full-text pattern counts over 50 unique ultrasound-to-speech studies (68 folders): vocoder_spectral_params 35, mel_spectrogram 17, neural_vocoder 16, formant_target 6. Formant-target hits (6 unique) checked by snippet: the target; the 2020 SSI review (arxiv-2009.02110 / doi-10.1109-access.2020.3026579) mentions formant trajectories only in a neurocomputational model; Conant et al. 2018 (pmc-5864145-vsmcvowel) uses formants only as an encoding-model predictor of cortical activity; isca-sonkar26_interspeech, arxiv-2506.03831 and doi-10.14232-phd.11818 are later. No ultrasound-to-speech study first public before 2020-06 predicts formants. Jaumard-Hakoun et al. 2016 (tongue and lip imaging to singing voice) predicts LSF. Denby and Stone 2004 (ICASSP) is not in the wiki.

In this study, we explored the ﬁrst two
formant frequencies - the most dominating parameters for speech trajectories.
the Mel-cepstral distortion (with the 95 % confidence interval calculated with a normal approximation) was found to be 7.6
Together with the gain, the MGC-LSP resulted in a 13-dimension feature vector
which resulted in F0, energy and 24-order spectral (MGC-LSP) features
layer Transformer before synthesis via HiFi-GAN vocoder.
It achieves the lowest overall WER of 15.93%
predict vocal tract properties via Line Spectral Frequencies
